text.content:
Available 3rd level · Fungal, light, gets where the ground doesn't go

Speed 35 ft, climb 20 ft · ignore plant/fungal difficult terrain · Melee cap-strike (agile, finesse) 2d4 bludgeoning
Green load

Allies who begin their turn adjacent to you gain 5 temporary Hit Points. You are seeding them, not healing them.

Grey load

Each creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 1d6 poison (basic Fortitude vs your Class DC). Spores don't care who breathes them.
